es.title: Hasio
es.extract: El hasio es un elemento sintético de la tabla periódica cuyo símbolo es Hs y su número atómico es 108. Su isótopo más estable es el Hs-269, que tiene un periodo de semidesintegración de 9,7 segundos.
es.description: elemento químico sintético, cuyo símbolo es Hs y número atómico es 108

en.title: Hassium
en.extract: Hassium is a synthetic chemical element; it has symbol Hs and atomic number 108. It is highly radioactive: its most stable known isotopes have half-lives of about ten seconds. One of its isotopes, 270Hs, has magic numbers of protons and neutrons for deformed nuclei, giving it greater stability against spontaneous fission. Hassium is a superheavy element; it has been produced in a laboratory in very small quantities by fusing heavy nuclei with lighter ones. Natural occurrences of hassium have been hypothesized but never found.
